rollback: Retain the v0.7 tag, source documents, database export, and evidence; discard or revert newly imported v0.8 records.

mappings.reason: A blueprint does not contain every v0.8 responsibility, authority, evidence, retry, and stop contract.
Portable intake facts and pre-Draft-PR state have an explicit mapping.
The v0.7 assertion does not bind every v0.8 repository, path, action, runner, capability, budget, time, merge, and deploy field; issue a new grant.
Port capability ranges, limitations, health, cancellation, and uncertainty must be declared explicitly.
No in-place database migration may invent v0.8 events, grants, leases, or evidence.

hard_stops: Any v0.7 state after DRAFT_PR_READY is rejected.
No legacy approval carries authority into v0.8.
Unknown state, permission, external side effect, or schema version fails closed.
No migration writes to an external service or source repository.
